spans.s:
mn. (-पः-पं)
A spreading creeper.
m. (-पः)
A reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
E.
वल to be strong, उपच् affix; also उलप and उलूप.

m. (-पः)
A spreading creeper.
n. (-पं)
A sort of grass.
f. (-पी)
A nymph of Pātāla married to ARJUNA.
E.
see उलुप.

m. (-पी)
A porpoise, or fish resembling it.
E.
उ for उत् up, लुप to disturb, &c. णिनि affix; also उलूपिन्, ऊलुपिन्, उल्लुपिन्, &c.

m. (-पी)
A porpoise, or fish resembling it: see उलुपिन्.

m. (-कः)
1 An owl.
2 A name of

One of the heroes of the Mahābhārata.
n. (-कं)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
E.
वल to be strong, ऊकः aff.

m. (-कः)
An owl.
E.
वल to be strong, and ऊक affix; व becomes ऊ.

n. (-लं)
1 A wooden mortar used for cleaning rice.
2 Bdellium, a gummy substance.
E.
उद्, up ख empty, and ल what takes: or उदू for उद्, and खल what goes; द is changed to लः see उदूखल.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Pounded in a mortar, cleansed.
E.
उलूखल and ठक् aff.

m. (-लः)
A name of Bdellium, a gummy substance, or the plant which produces it.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-तः)
A large snake, the Boa.
E.
उद् much, लू to cut, and क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Plucking out hair.
2 Cutting the hair.
E.
उद् up, लिचि to cut, affix ल्युट्.
